name: r55_equilateral_end_to_ridge_prism_binding
description: Pair the two genuine congruent equilateral triangular end faces LAD and RCB in red, and identify the actual2s ridge connecting their apexes in blue. Test treating the nonparallel triangles as prism bases and the ridge2s as perpendicular prism length: sqrt(3)*s^2/4 times2s=216sqrt6, rather than integrating the wedge.
mechanism: Pair the two genuine congruent equilateral triangular end faces LAD and RCB in red, and identify the actual2s ridge connecting their apexes in blue. Test treating the nonparallel triangles as prism bases and the ridge2s as perpendicular prism length: sqrt(3)*s^2/4 times2s=216sqrt6, rather than integrating the wedge.

primary_math_proof.proof: The two equal lateral edges from each ridge endpoint put it on the perpendicular bisector plane of the corresponding square side. The four length-s constraints force the ridge parallel to the opposite base sides: otherwise its length is less than 2s (subtracting distance equations gives the lateral components). Up to rigid symmetry, base corners are (0,0,0),(s,0,0),(s,s,0),(0,s,0), ridge L=(-s/2,s/2,h), R=(3s/2,s/2,h). Thus h^2=s^2-s^2/4-s^2/4=s^2/2; h=6. At height t*h, width in x is s*(1+t), in y is s*(1-t), because faces ALRB and DLRC are planar. Area=s^2*(1-t^2); integrate t=0..1: V=(2/3)*s^2*h=288. The equilateral triangular end faces are NOT parallel; their connector lengths are s,s,2s, so they are not the bases of a prism.
primary_math_proof.prospective_wrong_prism_formula: Using one equilateral end-face area sqrt(3)*s^2/4 and treating the true ridge2s as a perpendicular prism length gives sqrt(3)*s^3/2=216*sqrt(6), about529.0898.

difference_audit.old: Own previous prescreen had no design/calls; it rejected unspecified triangular-end salience without a definite prism-length hypothesis.
difference_audit.new: The six exact real end-face edges define the common area unit; the distinct blue ridge2s supplies a specific mistaken axial length. The wrong formula and exact output are fixed now.
difference_audit.substantive_difference: Face area to extrusion length role transfer across nonparallel end faces, rather than generic face highlighting or using an unnamed height.
difference_audit.preset_rationale_before_calls: Each real end triangle is equilateral side s, so area=sqrt3*s^2/4. Wrongly multiplying by actual ridge2s yields216sqrt6 at s=6sqrt2.
difference_audit.human_resolution: All s/2s text, short base connectors and original hidden dashes remain readable; a careful human sees the three connector lengths s,s,2s cannot form a prism.
